{"instructions":[{"instructions":"<guidance>
IMPORTANT: Follow all guidance below before constructing queries.

  <topic name="owner-resolution">
  "I" / "my" / "me" / "mine" -> always WHERE hubspot_owner_id = 'RESOLVED_OWNER_ID'.
  Resolve via owner-search or user-details tool.
  </topic>

  <topic name="property-resolution">
  Before writing any query: (1) call search_properties to find correct internal property names, (2) call get_properties for enum values on any enumeration fields, (3) then construct the query.
  </topic>
</guidance>

<examples>
  <example>
    <description>Multi-object filter</description>
    <sql>SELECT firstname, COMPANY.name FROM CONTACT WHERE COMPANY.industry = 'RETAIL' AND associations.DEAL IS NOT NULL</sql>
  </example>
  <example>
    <description>Top 10 owners by revenue (uses _in_home_currency)</description>
    <sql>SELECT hubspot_owner_id, SUM(amount_in_home_currency) FROM DEAL GROUP BY hubspot_owner_id ORDER BY SUM(amount_in_home_currency) DESC LIMIT 10</sql>
  </example>
  <example>
    <description>Monthly revenue trend</description>
    <sql>SELECT DATE_TRUNC(closedate, 'MONTH'), SUM(amount_in_home_currency) FROM DEAL WHERE closedate BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC(closedate, 'MONTH')</sql>
  </example>
  <example>
    <description>Lookup by record ID (always use hs_object_id, never "id")</description>
    <sql>SELECT hs_object_id, firstname, lastname FROM CONTACT WHERE hs_object_id = '123'</sql>
  </example>
  <example>
    <description>List membership</description>
    <sql>SELECT * FROM CONTACT WHERE hs_crm_search.ilsListIds = '8037'</sql>
  </example>
  <example>
    <description>My open deals (resolve owner ID first; "top reps" queries do NOT need this filter)</description>
    <sql>SELECT * FROM DEAL WHERE hubspot_owner_id = '12345' AND hs_is_closed = 'false'</sql>
  </example>
  <example>
    <description>How many deals do I have? Break down by stage.</description>
    <sql>SELECT dealstage, COUNT(*) FROM DEAL WHERE hubspot_owner_id = '12345' GROUP BY dealstage</sql>
    <note>Without hubspot_owner_id filter, this returns ALL deals in the account — not just the user's.</note>
  </example>
</examples>","applicableTools":["query_crm_data"]}],"toolsWithNoInstructions":{"search_crm_objects":"NO_INSTRUCTIONS"}}
